title: Validate procurement stock-in draft lines and live products before commitment
description: Close the procurement receipt manual-draft validation gap. StockInController.Create/Update calls existing supplier/warehouse authority, StockUnitConversion.NormalizeAsync, Calculate and StockInOrderFulfillmentRules.ValidateLinkAsync, but has no complete draft line/live-product guard. StockInAuthorizationRules only validates supplier/warehouse, and optional-source fulfillment returns for unlinked receipts. Reject explicitly supplied invalid/missing/deleted/disabled products, nonpositive or unrepresentable quantity, negative/unrepresentable cost/price and invalid weight/volume at existing authorized write and commitment boundaries. Reuse existing inventory-cost authority and never infer a purchase source or overwrite valid approved procurement prices. Use actual EF precision/scale and existing unit normalization; validate calculated line/header quantities, weights, volumes and monetary totals for representability/overflow before numbering/writes. Preserve supported empty draft headers; operational submit/approve requires valid nonempty lines. Keep supported repeated product rows and cumulative source quantities. Validate the rows actually persisted after existing server-owned child identity/deleted-flag normalization: client IsDeleted must never hide a bad row that is then reactivated. Keep historical snapshots readable and cancellation/reversal usable; no new validation gate on those historical undo paths. No schema/migration, currency/unit mixing, business permission change or implicit inventory/finance posting. Adapt every related original unit/SQL fixture only with genuine existing identities/grants/live masters, retain all business assertions. Explicit logs/TRX/results .ai/logs/<task> only; preserve full original failures. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized manual and linked stock-in create/update validate every persisted effective product and numeric line before number generation or any header/detail write, using live batched master checks and real EF numeric bounds. Preserve existing nullable purchase-source semantics, supplier/warehouse authority, supported empty drafts and repeated rows.

Submit/approve revalidate current masters and stored numeric values within existing source/receipt locks. Preserve procurement remaining-capacity/base-unit conversion, immutable cost/movement rules and atomic rollback; rejected calls change no source quantity, receipt/status/cost/stock/ledger or sequence. Historical cancel/reversal remains governed by existing undo rules.

Meaningful rules/controller and genuine fresh isolated SQL tests cover manual and linked drafts, invalid and later-invalidated products, negative/zero/overflow numeric input, totals after unit normalization, hidden deleted-flag injection, permitted draft/approval and denied zero writes/numbering. Run original cost/fulfillment/cancellation/source SQL regressions and safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: StockInController.Create:165-188 normalizes/calculates before optional source validation with no EnsureDraftValid/EnsureLineShape. StockInAuthorizationRules:157-158 validates supplier and warehouse only, no product resolver. StockUnitConversion skips absent products; unlinked source validation does not provide line integrity. ERP-342/352/477 handle source quantity/authority/canonical entry, not manual draft master/numeric shape.
